$comment: Local extension: upstream SAP abap-file-formats has no view schema. Field names and value ranges are derived from the DDIC maintenance structures DD25V (header), DD26V (included tables), DD27P (view fields), DD28J (join conditions) and DD28V (selection conditions), verified on S/4HANA with DDIF_VIEW_GET / DDIF_VIEW_PUT.
title: Database View Properties
description: ABAP DDIC database view (SE11 view) properties

originalLanguage.title: Original Language
originalLanguage.description: Two-letter ISO language code of the original definition (DD25V-DDLANGUAGE)

name.title: View Name
name.description: DDIC view name (DD25V-VIEWNAME). At most 16 characters, like the DDIC view object name limit.

package.title: Package
package.description: Package recorded for the view in TADIR (read-side only; create/push take the package from the command line).

rootTable.title: Root Table
rootTable.description: Root table of the view (DD25V-ROOTTAB). Must equal the first tables[] entry.

tables.title: Included Tables
tables.description: Tables the view is built on (DD26V), in join order.

tablePosition.title: Table Position
tablePosition.description: DD26V-TABPOS, 1-based. Derived from the array order when omitted.

foreignTableName.title: Foreign Table Name
foreignTableName.description: DD26V-FORTABNAME: root table for outer joins (SE11 fills the root table for every non-root entry).

forField.title: Foreign Key Field
forField.description: DD26V-FORFIELD: foreign-key field, used by help views.

forDirection.title: Foreign Key Direction
forDirection.description: DD26V-FORDIR: foreign-key direction, used by help views.

fields.title: View Fields
fields.description: Fields of the view (DD27P), in selection order.

tableName.title: Table Name
tableName.description: DD27P-TABNAME: table the field comes from.

fieldName.title: Field Name
fieldName.description: DD27P-FIELDNAME: field of the underlying table.

keyFlag.title: Key Flag
keyFlag.description: DD27P-KEYFLAG. Derived from the underlying table field on write.

rollName.title: Data Element
rollName.description: DD27P-ROLLNAME. Derived from the underlying table field on write.

joinConditions.title: Join Conditions
joinConditions.description: Inner-join conditions of the view (DD28J). Required for a view built on more than one table.

source.title: Condition Source
source.description: DD28J-SOURCE. 'S' is what SE11 writes for database views.

selectionConditions.title: Selection Conditions
selectionConditions.description: Fixed value conditions of the view (DD28V). Database views normally have none.
